s: This page lists crop growth tables for all
. The "Base" table shows growth without the
profession and without any growth fertilizer. Below each Base table, comparisons between growth fertilizers and the Agriculturist Profession are shown. Note that the increase in growth is 10% with
or the Agriculturist Profession, so the "10%" table applies to each.
With the exception of multi-harvest crops, the tables assume that seeds are replanted and watered on the day of harvest.
